text.p: Swift Transportation Co Inc on Friday said it signed a letter of intent to acquire assets of Direct Transit Inc, a dry van carrier in North Sioux City, S.D. with operations primarily in the eastern United States.
Direct Transit is currently a debtor-in-possession in U.S. Bankruptcy Court.

Under terms of the proposed deal, Swift will acquire the inventory, equipment and intellectual property of DTI. It will negotiate with DTI's revenue equipment lessors for new leases or purchases of the equipment.
Also, Swift and DTI have agreed to a proposed interim management agreement pending the closing of the transaction.
Because of the transaction, Swift said it will delay the release of its 1996 year end financial results until Jan. 31.
